name: app-sidebar
title: App sidebar
description: Dashboard navigation with workspace controls, search, grouped links, and footer actions. Opens as a drawer on phones.
avoid: Animating the switch between link lists
notes: The navigation scrolls independently when the links exceed the available height. Edge fades indicate hidden links, and the bottom chevron scrolls farther down. Icons are optional on `SidebarLink` and `SidebarButton`.

reference.scope: Source reference; dashboard behavior cannot be verified on the public marketing site.
